description: Post archive of a beehiiv newsletter (by beehiiv subdomain, e.g. superhuman, or the newsletter's own domain if hosted on beehiiv): newsletter name, total posts, and per post title, subtitle, URL, publish time, authors, free/premium audience, tags and reading time, 10 per page, newest first. Optional word filter within the page. Public archive data, no key; post bodies are not returned. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

newsletter.description: beehiiv subdomain (superhuman → superhuman.beehiiv.com) or the newsletter's domain/URL (e.g. www.superhuman.ai)

page.description: Archive page, 1 or more (default 1), 10 posts per page

q.description: Words that must all appear in the title or subtitle (filters this page only; optional)
